properties.bedrock_type: Puente Formation and Topanga Formation sedimentary marine sandstone and siltstone
properties.mineralogy: Quartz, feldspar, interbedded marine shale, and Quaternary alluvium deposits along base of Hollywood Hills
properties.drainage: Engineered municipal subterranean stormwater conduit network draining southward toward Ballona Creek watershed

properties.primary_surfacing: Dense graded asphaltic concrete roadway (Sunset Boulevard) with integrated aggregate concrete curbs and sidewalks
properties.wear_characteristics: Thermoplastic painted crosswalk striping, turn lane arrows, 'KEEP CLEAR' road stencils, subtle longitudinal seam patching, and fine asphalt micro-fissuring
properties.micro_grading: Curvilinear east-northeast ascending road corridor conforming to the toe of the Santa Monica Mountain foothills

properties.groundcover: Cultivated hillside landscaping, drought-tolerant low shrubbery, and terraced residential ornamental plantings on the ascending left slopes

properties.primary_building_typology: Commercial Sunset Strip corridor comprising high-rise hospitality towers, mid-rise commercial retail buildings, and large-scale structural steel cantilevered billboard superstructures

structures.weathering_patina: pristine architectural glazing with subtle urban dust on horizontal mullions
